A delivery app that calls each service one at a time stops when one of them goes down. With Kafka, the orders service writes the event once to a topic and moves on; each service reads at its own pace, and whoever was down reads what it missed when it comes back. The cost: one more cluster to run, or a managed service.

Would you connect your services directly or through a topic? Tell me in the comments.

Source: Apache Kafka 4.4 documentation (Introduction and Design). Part 1 of 4 of the Kafka series.

The author's voice is cloned with AI. Animations made for this video; fictional app, services and orders.
